_about: Pitchside challenges. 'weekly' rotate one per ISO week (week number modulo the list); each is a Tracka drill Pep can measure, so results are numbers from measurement and count on Me as a skill area.
'fun' challenges are always on: no measurement, just clips players post. Football opinion: review with coaches.

weekly.name: Weak-foot wall passes in 30 seconds
weekly.how: Weaker foot only. Every clean pass back to you counts.
steps: Stand 2 big steps from a wall
Phone 3 to 4 steps back, on its side

weekly.name: Keepy-ups: how many in a row?
weekly.how: Any part of the body except your arms. Your best run counts.
steps: Find flat ground with space around you
Phone on its side, all of you in shot
Start with the ball in your hands

weekly.name: 5-10-5 shuttle
weekly.how: Three cones 5 metres apart. Touch each line with your hand.
steps: Put 3 cones in a line, 5 m apart
Phone side-on, all 3 cones in shot
Mark the cones when you upload

weekly.name: 30 m sprint
weekly.how: Flat out from a standing start. Fastest time wins.
steps: Phone side-on, far enough back to see the whole run
Mark the cones when you upload

fun.name: Crossbar challenge
fun.how: Hit the bar from the edge of the box.

fun.name: Keepy-uppies with a friend
fun.how: Pass it back and forth, no bounce.
